taiwan_aviation.headline: 國防部通報19架次共機活動 13架次越過臺海中線
taiwan_aviation.summary: 國防部10月9日通報，自上午8時52分起偵獲19架次共軍軍機及無人機，其中13架次越過臺灣海峽中線，進入臺灣北部、中部與西南空域，並配合共艦活動。國軍派遣任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統應處。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan reports 19 PLA aircraft sorties, 13 crossing the Taiwan Strait median line
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan’s defence ministry said on October 9 that it detected 19 PLA aircraft sorties from 08:52, including 13 that crossed the Taiwan Strait median line into northern, central and southwestern airspace while operating alongside Chinese naval vessels. Taiwan said it responded with aircraft, ships and shore-based missile systems.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 經濟部核定27件無人機研發補助 漢翔獲年度單案最高1億元
taiwan_aviation.summary: 經濟部核定27件無人機研發補助，總額約新臺幣7.8億元；漢翔高承載物流無人機計畫獲1億元，為年度單案最高。六案為整機研發，另21案支持關鍵技術；補助核定不代表產品已完成驗證或取得商業飛航許可。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan approves 27 drone R&D grants, with AIDC receiving the largest award at TWD100 million
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan’s economy ministry approved 27 drone R&D grants worth about TWD780 million. AIDC’s heavy-payload logistics-drone project received TWD100 million, the year’s largest individual award. Six grants cover complete aircraft and 21 support key technologies; the funding does not mean the product has completed validation or received commercial flight approval.

international_aviation.headline: 美國陸軍報告指出無線電通訊中斷促成2025年致命空中相撞
international_aviation.summary: 美國陸軍公開調查報告，指出兩次無線電通訊中斷是2025年1月29日美國航空Flight 5342客機與陸軍直升機致命相撞的促成因素之一。報告稱，直升機相撞時高度約278英尺，高於指定航線200英尺的最高許可高度；陸軍並表示，3,585架受影響旋翼航空器已於2025年7月31日前完成ADS-B設定檢查。
international_aviation.headline_en: U.S. Army report cites interrupted radio transmissions as a factor in 2025 fatal midair collision
international_aviation.summary_en: A U.S. Army investigation report identified two interrupted radio transmissions as a contributing factor in the fatal collision between American Airlines Flight 5342 and an Army helicopter on 29 January 2025. The helicopter was at about 278 feet above sea level, above the 200-foot route limit. The Army said 3,585 affected rotary-wing aircraft had completed ADS-B configuration checks by 31 July 2025.

international_aviation.headline: Meteomatics發表Strato氣象無人機 可升至4,245英尺蒐集資料
international_aviation.summary: 瑞士Meteomatics於10月8日發表小型多旋翼氣象無人機Strato，可升至4,245英尺高空蒐集資料。公司表示，Strato可承受每小時80英里的持續風，並配備加熱系統防止旋翼結冰。
international_aviation.headline_en: Meteomatics unveils Strato weather drone, capable of reaching 4,245 feet
international_aviation.summary_en: Swiss firm Meteomatics unveiled its small multicopter weather drone, Strato, on October 8. The drone can climb to 4,245 feet to collect meteorological data. The company says it can withstand sustained winds of up to 80 mph and has a heating system to prevent rotor icing.

international_aviation.headline: 加拿大航空公布A321XLR往返蒙特婁、哈利法克斯與歐洲的新航線計畫
international_aviation.summary: 加拿大航空公布以A321XLR開通蒙特婁與哈利法克斯飛往歐洲的新航線計畫，飛行時間最長達8小時。客艙將設14間平躺式商務艙套房並提供免費WiFi；營運細節與時刻表仍待確認。
international_aviation.headline_en: Air Canada announces planned A321XLR routes from Montreal and Halifax to Europe
international_aviation.summary_en: Air Canada announced plans for A321XLR services linking Montreal and Halifax with Europe, with flights of up to eight hours. The aircraft will have 14 lie-flat business-class suites and complimentary Wi-Fi. Operational details and schedules are still awaiting confirmation.

international_aviation.headline: 空中巴士9月交付72架 前三季累計547架、第四季還須交付323架達標
international_aviation.summary: 空中巴士9月交付72架商用飛機，2026年前九個月累計交付547架。若要達成約870架的年度目標，第四季仍須交付323架，平均每月近108架；公司9月另取得17架新訂單。
international_aviation.headline_en: Airbus delivers 72 aircraft in September, with 323 more needed to meet its 2026 target
international_aviation.summary_en: Airbus delivered 72 commercial aircraft in September, bringing its 2026 total to 547. It needs to deliver 323 more in the fourth quarter to reach its annual target of about 870, requiring an average of nearly 108 per month. The manufacturer also recorded 17 new orders in September.

international_aviation.headline: 泰國王后蘇提達駕駛Saab Gripen完成41分鐘單飛
international_aviation.summary: 泰國王后蘇提達10月8日駕駛泰國皇家空軍單座Saab JAS 39C Gripen完成預定單飛，41分鐘後返回Wing 7。她飛行前已累積逾1,100飛行小時，並成為泰國首位女性Gripen飛行員。
international_aviation.headline_en: Thailand’s Queen Suthida completes 41-minute solo flight in a Saab Gripen
international_aviation.summary_en: Queen Suthida of Thailand completed a planned solo flight in a Royal Thai Air Force single-seat Saab JAS 39C Gripen on October 8, returning to Wing 7 after 41 minutes. She had logged more than 1,100 flying hours and became Thailand’s first female Gripen pilot.

international_aviation.headline: 波音為737 MAX與NG提供觸控控制面板 飛行員質疑顛簸時操作性
international_aviation.summary: 波音提供觸控式控制顯示單元，供737 MAX與NG替換原有實體按鈕面板；新面板將成為737 MAX 10標準配備，也可供其他MAX與NG客機改裝。飛行員認為觸控螢幕在顛簸時較難操作，波音則強調其可靠性、成本與重量效益。
international_aviation.headline_en: Boeing offers touchscreen control units for 737 MAX and NG as pilots question use in turbulence
international_aviation.summary_en: Boeing is offering a touchscreen replacement for the control display unit on 737 MAX and NG aircraft. It will be standard on the MAX 10 and can also be retrofitted to other MAX and NG aircraft. Pilots say touchscreens are harder to use in turbulence, while Boeing cites reliability, cost and weight benefits.
